Mike H: quick q about /v1/generate usage fields — we stream responses and the SDK currently reports prompt_tokens / completion_tokens / cached_tokens. How should cached tokens be treated for billing and for streaming partial deltas?

Julia P: short answer: historically cached tokens were included in the prompt_tokens value but we excluded them from billing in the pipeline. thats caused confusion.

Ashok V: so the API returns prompt_tokens that may include cached prefix, meaning total_tokens != billable_tokens? how do streaming clients compute billable deltas while receiving chunks?

Sara L: propose we add explicit fields to the response instead of changing semantics: e.g.
```json
{
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 120,
    "completion_tokens": 80,
    "total_tokens": 200,
    "cached_prefix_tokens": 40,
    "cached_completion_tokens": 0,
    "billable_prompt_tokens": 80,
    "billable_total_tokens": 160
  }
}
```
This makes streaming safe: client can subtract cached_* from prompt delta to compute billable deltas.

billing-bot: FYI — billing pipeline currently looks at invoiceable_tokens which equals total_tokens - cached_prefix_tokens when customer has opt-out enabled. Customers have a feature flag `count_cached_tokens` that toggles this behavior. See infra/ops/billing/README.md#cache-handling. :information_source:

Kevin R: agree with adding new fields rather than repurposing prompt_tokens. Backcompat rule: never change meaning of existing fields; always add new top-level usage fields or a compatibility map.

Julia P: +1. implementation notes: runtime already annotates frames with origin=cache vs origin=live. we can aggregate those counts into cached_* fields at the router before returning. PR should include unit tests for streaming partials (simulate prefix cached then live tokens).

Ashok V: one edge: when streaming, partial "token_count" events come in. client needs deterministic formula to increment billable counter. recommended algorithm: on each chunk, billable_delta = delta_total_tokens_in_chunk - delta_cached_tokens_in_chunk; ensure floor at 0. keep cumulative billable from server fields as authoritative if present.

Mike H: action items: 1) Sara — open RFC PR with response schema + migration plan (add examples for streaming SDK). 2) Julia/Ashok — add router aggregation + streaming tests. 3) Kevin — quick check with billing infra for feature flag behavior. 4) Billing-bot — post back any constraints. 5) I'll ping for code review once RFC is up.

Mike H: thanks all :thumbsup:
